name: 王明道
objective:
Studio in media design for the senior. Students are expected to exhibit a full range of professional competence and facility in designing advanced media and component complexes of broad scope. All phases of each project design are brought to a professional level under the supervision of the director. This course emphasizes presentation techniques, including verbal, visual, and written. A project report is required.

以專題研究方式訓練學生獨立企劃，分析，評斷，歸納及創新思考的能力。並藉由對視覺美學，媒體技術，媒體機能相關性等問題之深入探討，實際演練媒體設計之過程及熟練媒體設計之技巧.
schedule:
Topic, Media, Instructor Intro &Grouping
Operation Planning for Interactive Exp.
Operation Development for Inter. Exp.
Operation Simulation for Inter. Exp.
Out-campus Exhibition
Design Proposal Discussion
Low-Fidelity Prototype Development I
Low-Fidelity Prototype Development II
Joint Review 1: Project Proposal Review
High-Fidelity Prototype Development I
High-Fidelity Prototype Development II
High-Fidelity Prototype Development III
Joint Review 2: Hi-Fi Prototype Review
Interactive Prototype Development I
Interactive Prototype Development II
Interactive Prototype Development III
Joint Review 3: Final Presentation
Review of Final Evaluation
scorePolicy:
[Out-campus Exhibition] 30%
[Joint Review 1] Project Proposal with Low-fidelity Prototype: 10%
[Joint Review 2] High-fidelity Prototype: 15%
[Joint Review 3] Final Prototype Demonstration: 25%
Class Participation and Engagement: 20%
延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL / 專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
